$$ \text{refracted} = n \cdot (\text{ray} - s \cdot N) - N \cdot \sqrt{1 - n^2 \cdot (1 - s^2)} $$ [S1, unofficial].

The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly defines the calculation for the refracted ray. Specifically, it calculates `n = n1 / n2`, `s = dot(ray, N)`, and then computes the refracted vector using the formula `n * (ray - s * N) - N * sqrt(1 - n * n * (1 - s * s))`. This matches the mathematical claim provided exactly.
